name: Omnisend
description: Omnisend is an ecommerce marketing platform for contacts, campaigns, email, SMS, push, automation, segments, products, and analytics.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Omnisend brand through Relay-owned OAuth with exactly contacts.read and campaigns.read. Relay pins Omnisend-Version 2026-03-15, binds one 24-character contact and campaign ID, exposes only IDs and lifecycle metadata, and blocks contact identifiers, consent, message content, audiences, analytics, broader resources, exports, and mutations.

credentialRequirements.name: OMNISEND_CLIENT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Relay Omnisend OAuth client ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Railway-held Relay OAuth client ID configured with the exact callback and two read scopes.

credentialRequirements.name: OMNISEND_CLIENT_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Relay Omnisend OAuth client secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Railway-held Omnisend client secret; never sent to clients or agents.

credentialRequirements.name: OMNISEND_CONTACT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Selected contact ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: The exact 24-character contact ID whose ID and timestamps Relay may read.

credentialRequirements.name: OMNISEND_CAMPAIGN_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Selected campaign ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: The exact 24-character campaign ID whose bounded lifecycle metadata Relay may read.

capabilities.label: Read selected contact summary
capabilities.description: Read only the ID and timestamps for one selected contact without identifiers, names, addresses, consent, channels, tags, custom properties, segments, or activity.

capabilities.label: Read selected campaign summary
capabilities.description: Read bounded lifecycle metadata for one selected campaign without name, content, sender, audience, UTM, A/B, booster, or analytics details.

allowed.label: Read selected contact summary
allowed.description: Read the selected contact's ID and timestamps while discarding every identifier, consent, profile, segment, and activity field.

allowed.label: Read selected campaign summary
allowed.description: Read the selected campaign's ID, type, channel, status, and timestamps while discarding private campaign and analytics fields.

blocked.label: Expose private marketing data
blocked.description: Contact identifiers, names, addresses, consent, channels, tags, custom properties, segments, and activity plus campaign name, content, sender, audience, UTM, A/B, booster, and analytics data are excluded.

blocked.label: Mutate Omnisend state
blocked.description: Contacts, campaigns, content, audiences, sends, schedules, templates, events, segments, products, and every other mutation are blocked.

blocked.label: Use broad Omnisend access
blocked.description: Other contacts, campaigns, lists, segments, templates, events, analytics, arbitrary paths, queries, cursors, redirects, downloads, and exports are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Read Only
approvalProfiles.description: Read one selected contact and campaign through a two-scope Relay OAuth grant; private data, broader access, analytics, and mutations remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway stores the Relay-owned Omnisend OAuth token server-side and mounts exactly two version-pinned projected reads.
Railway stores the Relay-owned Omnisend OAuth token server-side and mounts exactly two version-pinned projected reads.

providerSetup.blocker: An Omnisend OAuth app, exact Railway callback, provider-issued client credentials, authorized staging brand, selected contact and campaign IDs, and live grant are required. No authorized account or credentials are available in this worker lane.
providerSetup.nextAction: The provider-console lane must register Relay's OAuth app with the exact callback and two read scopes, capture credentials in Railway, authorize a staging brand, bind selected IDs, then validate both redacted reads, version pinning, scope denial, retired-version and rate errors, user revocation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial in Fairfax.

evidence.supports: Omnisend documents authorization-code OAuth, app client credentials, requested resource scopes, bearer access, provider token endpoint, and access lasting until user revocation.
Omnisend documents GET /api/contacts/{id}, contacts.read, the mandatory Omnisend-Version 2026-03-15 header, and safe validation, auth, scope, not-found, retired-version, rate, and server errors.
Omnisend documents GET /api/campaigns/{id}, campaigns.read, 24-character hexadecimal campaign IDs, the pinned version header, and bounded error semantics.
Omnisend documents campaign lifecycle fields and the message content, sender, audience, scheduling, A/B, booster, UTM, and mutation capabilities Relay excludes.
